split_policy.primary_axis: generated provenance role before replay directory, generator label, fixture generation metadata, report output, migration-only row, generated-output-only row, or fixture basename
split_policy.positive_rule: generated inventory rows never define positive parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e behavior; they may only point at canonical fixture truth owned elsewhere
split_policy.canonical_truth_rule: canonical behavior truth remains in tests/native and behavior owner indexes, not generated artifacts
split_policy.report_only_rule: generated reports, replay packets, manifest entries, generator paths, validation outputs, generated-output-only rows, migration-only rows, and fixture generation metadata are provenance-only until canonical behavior owners claim support
split_policy.fixture_generation_metadata_rule: origin, generator, provenance, allowed path roots, hand-edit policy, source-of-truth labels, validation payload ids, replay run labels, and phase-support-authority flags are fixture generation metadata and cannot define behavior
split_policy.migration_only_rule: migration-only, generated-output-only, report-only, replay-only, validation-packet-only, and generator-output-only rows stay provenance or rejection even when they reference canonical fixture paths
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode, shim, fallback, compatibility, unsupported, alternate acceptance, report-only, generated-output-only, generator-output-only, migration-only, replay-only, and validation-packet-only claims are strict rejection, canonical rejection, or provenance-only evidence
